question: Will Russian and Ukrainian officials hold a round of negotiations on an energy-infrastructure ceasefire between October 15 and October 17, 2026?

calls.reasoning: As of Oct 4-7 2026, the US proposes a technical-level trilateral meeting (likely Abu Dhabi) on an energy ceasefire 'by end of October'; Ukraine says it is ready, and the Kremlin says October is 'possible' but no date or package is set and Russian officials say detailed preparations are not underway. P(a qualifying round in October at all) is roughly 35-45%; the chance it falls in the specific Oct 15-17 window given that is roughly 15-25%, since the remaining days run Oct 8-31 and the first round could easily slip into November. Past rounds were announced a few days ahead, and none is announced yet. Market check: none on this exact question; Polymarket ceasefire-by-Oct-31 (~7%) is a different contract (a ceasefire taking effect, not talks being held), so it is not used as an anchor. Kalshi has no matching market.

- The Atlantic via Liga.net, ~Sep 29 2026: the US wants October talks in Abu Dhabi on a limited ceasefire (energy infrastructure, Black Sea).
- Axios, Sep 24 2026: Zelensky says the US is pushing an energy ceasefire, a Black Sea grain corridor and a trilateral meeting; Ukraine is 'ready' for an energy ceasefire.
- TASS, Sep 13 2026: Peskov says October is 'certainly a possibility' for trilateral talks; no commitment.
- Izvestia, Sep 25 2026: Karasin (Federation Council) says contacts are 'not being prepared in detail', only general discussion; Peskov says 'no real prerequisites' for peace talks yet; the last trilateral round was Geneva, Feb 17-18 2026. Kremlin adviser Ushakov (Freepressjournal): no 'coordinated package' yet.
- TASS/ua.news, late Sep: Peskov says Russia is not engaged in substantive energy-truce negotiations; Rubio, after meeting Lavrov, says both sides expressed interest in a partial energy/grain ceasefire.
- History: 2026 trilateral rounds were Abu Dhabi Jan 23-24 and Feb 4-5, then Geneva Feb 17-18; each was announced only days in advance. A one-week energy truce in late Jan 2026 was violated (Feb 3 strike).
- Status quo as of Oct 7: no round scheduled; preparatory contacts only.

calls.reconciliation: All three runs share the same evidence base and land at 6-8%. The disputes were small: (1) whether the US timing is 'late October' or 'by end of October'. Both appear in the dossiers and I could not check which is right, but either puts most of the probability after Oct 17, and 'late October' weighs slightly toward the lower end. (2) Putin's Oct 1 'ridiculous' remark appears only in Run 3; I could not verify it, but it is consistent with Peskov's 'no substantive discussions' and the escalating strikes, so I give it moderate weight. (3) The judgments on P(October round) and on the in-window share have no tie-breaking evidence; I take 30-40% x 15-20% plus a little extra for a confirmed call, giving about 6%. No market anchor exists.
